allocation_regime: common_ceiling_comparison; E0 and E1 share one identical resource policy, so allocation is not a confound
one_factor_changed: input form only. Same 51 gVCFs, same per-contig interval plan, same reference, same batch size, same ceilings, same concurrency.

correctness.conclusion: byte-identical callset; the input form changed nothing about the result

performance.conclusion: no measurable performance difference at 51 samples. All deltas are within run-to-run noise for wall time, and both import peaks sit far below their 16 GiB allocation, so the import RSS difference is not a meaningful effect.

command_length_is_not_a_constraint.note: A commonly cited reason to adopt sample-name-map does not apply here. The repeated-variant form remains about 0.6% of ARG_MAX at 327 samples, so it would not fail on command length. This reason is recorded as not supporting the decision.

sample_ordering_was_not_exercised.finding: This cohort's 51 run accessions are already in lexicographic order, and the repeated-variant order, the map file order and the output sample order are all identical to sorted order.
sample_ordering_was_not_exercised.implication: GATK derives sample order from the map when one is given. Because sorted order and input order coincide here, E1 could not have detected a reordering difference between the two input forms. A byte-identical result at 51 samples is therefore not evidence that the two forms agree on ordering for a cohort whose sample names are not already sorted.
sample_ordering_was_not_exercised.condition_for_327: Before adopting at 327 samples, confirm the production samplesheet order against sorted sample-name order, or accept the map's sorted order as the contract and verify the output sample order explicitly.

limitations.scale: measured at 51 samples only; no header-loading advantage for very large cohorts was observable at this size

rationale: Adoption is justified on data-integrity and auditability grounds rather than performance. The map carries an explicit index path per sample, enables GATK's own map validation, and is a single checksummable artefact recording exactly which gVCFs entered a run, which matters more at 327 inputs than at 51. It costs nothing measurable and changes nothing about the callset. The command-length argument is explicitly not part of this rationale, and adoption is conditional on the sample-ordering check above.
not_claimed: No performance benefit is claimed. No accuracy change is claimed; there is no truth set, and the callsets are byte-identical in any case.
